parsed.note_claim: On 2 January 2024, Japan Airlines Flight 516 collided with a Japan Coast Guard DHC-8 at Haneda Airport, resulting in all JAL passengers surviving and five Coast Guard fatalities.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Five of the six crew on board the Dash 8 died in the collision, leaving only the captain alive. Everyone on board the A350 survived.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms the date, location, aircraft involved, and the specific survival and fatality counts for both flights mentioned in the note.
